settings.description: Three ways to work together, from an afternoon course to three months of private mentoring.

settings.heading: Pick the one that fits this year

settings.label: Studio Foundations
settings.heading: A studio that runs on purpose, not on overtime
settings.text: Twelve weeks in a small group to set prices you can say out loud, find two or three clients worth keeping, and build a week with real edges. One live call every Tuesday, short lessons in between, and me in your corner.
settings.facts: 12 weeks | Live calls on Tuesdays | 12 places

settings.label: Price It Right
settings.heading: Price your next project in an afternoon
settings.text: A short self paced course on the numbers behind a fair quote: your real hourly cost, a day rate that holds, and how to present a price without apologising for it. Comes with the calculator I still use.
settings.facts: Self paced | About three hours | Calculator included

settings.label: One to one
settings.heading: Three months of private mentoring
settings.text: For studio owners making a bigger move: hiring a first person, raising every price at once, or changing what the studio does. Fortnightly calls, a shared notebook and quick answers between calls.
settings.facts: Three months | Fortnightly calls | Two places a quarter
settings.pin_text: Short application, reply within a week

settings.text: Something else on your mind? Write to me, I read every message.

settings.question: Who are the programmes for?
settings.answer: Designers, makers, architects, photographers and small studio owners who sell their own work or time. Most clients have been in business for at least a year and are busy but not earning what they should.

settings.question: How much time does Studio Foundations take?
settings.answer: About three hours a week: the Tuesday call, one short lesson and one piece of homework you do on your own business. Calls are recorded if you miss one.

settings.question: What if I am not ready for a programme?
settings.answer: Start with the free worksheet and the show. Price It Right is a good next step: it takes an afternoon and you keep it for good.

settings.question: Can I pay in instalments?
settings.answer: Yes. Studio Foundations and mentoring can be paid in three monthly parts at checkout, with no extra cost.

settings.question: What if it is not working for me?
settings.answer: Tell me within the first two weeks of any programme and I refund you in full. For Price It Right, within 30 days.

settings.question: Do you work with teams?
settings.answer: Yes, for studios of up to ten people. Write to me with what is going on and I will suggest the best way in.
